reason: The R-centered trigonal cell (a approximately 11.588 A, c approximately 6.560 A), its primitive-volume/Z=3 interpretation, and a broadly compatible Fe-As framework are well supported, but the submitted exact R3 realization is not. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied, and an independent profile calculation for selected.cif still gives an unweighted whole-profile residual of about 0.240 after optimizing intensity falloff, scale, and background. It has major intensity contradictions, including severe underprediction at 49.78, 83.32, and 89.09 degrees and overprediction at 36.17, 38.39, and 59.71 degrees, as well as calculated reflections where the observed profile is nearly empty. The trajectory selected lower-symmetry R3 using custom stick-intensity objectives rather than a validated Rietveld fit; close R-3/R32 models existed, and the scientifically motivated alternative R3 Wyckoff topology search was interrupted without a result. Thus the cell and Z are substantially better established than the submitted symmetry, coordinates, occupancies/site topology, and element ordering, and a materially different model could plausibly improve the candidate set.
